subject: see number of times an app was accessed

messages.author: a8c73113f8e105ae
messages.subject: see number of times an app was accessed
parts:
Does anyone know how to see the total number of times an app has been accessed?  I can see the number of hours for which it can be accessed, but I'd like to know how many times anyone has actually attempted to use an app.

Thanks,

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] see number of times an app was accessed
parts:
Hi Paul,
The easiest thing to do is to hook up google analytics to your application.  Here is an article that talks about how you would go about doing that in a shiny application:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/google-analytics.html

-Tareef
